children: CNX appointed Ravi Srivastava as Chief Financial Officer, succeeding Everett W. Good who stepped down as CFO and will remain as a consultant through the end of 2026.
Former Chief Financial Officer (will serve as consultant)
September 17, 2026 (stepped down); consulting through end of 2026
Mutual agreement to step down; to pursue other career opportunities; not due to disagreement with Company
Replaced by Ravi Srivastava as CFO

Age 45; SVP Operations since Feb 2025; joined Company 2010; prior roles include President, New Technologies; VP – Data and Operations Technology; degrees: B.E. (Bluefield State), M.Eng. Mgmt (Penn State), MBA (MIT)
Over 13 years with Company; will receive lump sum payment and equity vesting/accelerations in connection with consulting agreement
Age 43; VP Financial Reporting & Controller since May 2026; prior Director of Accounting; degrees: B.S. Accounting (Slippery Rock), MBA (Univ. of Pittsburgh)
